policy.max_age_applies_to: active (non-merged, non-archived) entries only; expires is a review date, not a deletion deadline

retirement.trigger: a status=merged entry past its expires review date whose remote branch no longer exists (printed as RETIRE DUE)
retirement.action: remove the entry from branches[] in a governance PR; Git history keeps the audit trail
retirement.verification: python scripts/check_branch_registry.py --today <date> exits 0 with no EXPIRED

policy.note: A remote branch without a registry entry is a governance failure once the CI check is enabled. This file is a local registry; it does not query the network. Register a new branch here in the same PR that creates it. It records branches ever created, not a live list of remote branches. status records the branch's disposition when the entry landed on main, not a live PR state; entries written before 2026-11-11 used a live-state meaning. status=archived is a deliberate permanent snapshot with no PR, exempt from the pr field and from max_age_days. expires is a review date: status=merged past it is reported as RETIRE DUE (report-only, never a CI failure) and is retired in the monthly governance pass; active statuses past it still fail as EXPIRED. Invalid date strings always fail.
